M_semantics: requested M is the frozen action output, not a rejection gate or budget cap; infeasible distinct/capped action becomes explicit zero-flow rather than selecting zero-weight tickets
accounting: one realized multiplicity is one independent ¥2 ticket/tax unit; requested stake = 2*sum multiplicities; no aggregation

input_order.matches: exact Stage-2 ordered_match_ids, unchanged from Stage 1

mechanisms.CAPPED_REPEAT: accepted #145 capped Hamilton only when M <= positive_support*cap; otherwise NO_BET
mechanisms.DETERMINISTIC_TOP_MASS: accepted #145 weight-desc/ordinal-asc only when M <= positive support; otherwise NO_BET
mechanisms.FULL_ENUMERATED: enumerate each positive Stage-2 ticket exactly once; ALLOW_ALL gives 2187, reduced support gives explicit ENUMERATE_UPSTREAM_SUPPORT_FALLBACK
mechanisms.RESIDUAL_SYSTEMATIC: accepted #145 Hamilton allocation; repeats allowed on positive support
mechanisms.WOR_DISTINCT: accepted #145 exponential keys only when M <= positive support; otherwise NO_BET
mechanisms.WR_DUPLICATE_STAKE: accepted #145 inverse-CDF on normalized vector; duplicates retained; zero weights forbidden from realized counts

outcome_boundary: Gate A outcome-unexposed: target result, final/winning SP, payout, tax realization, ROI, settlement, and any post-cutoff evidence are forbidden from X_i, every stage output, fitting inputs, screens, and tie-breaks

stage3_role_vector_source.identity_rule: all seven role rows must share exact nonblank portfolio_id and issue and match the ordered Stage-1 support by match_id; missing row/field or mixed identity is UNAVAILABLE with zero flow

weight_vector.identity: SHA-256 of canonical 17-digit float strings in ordinal order
weight_vector.normalization: math.fsum raw total; divide each raw weight; apply residual 1-math.fsum to the last positive ordinal
weight_vector.rule: for each ordered match/code multiply the bound #137 Stage-3 source weight by the Stage-2 estimator direction weight when the code is allowed, otherwise exact zero; NA control source is unit weight; retain a length-2187 vector with explicit zeros
